selectedAudience.title: Active adults with recurring knee pain
selectedAudience.description: Placeholder audience for the example playbook. Runners, hikers, and weekend athletes in their 30s to 50s whose knee pain keeps returning, who want to stay active without surgery, and who have already tried resting it away. Replace this whole file with the playbook your brand research produces.

audienceState.currentState: Training around a knee that flares up every few weeks, googling symptoms at night, and quietly skipping the activities they love because they no longer trust the joint.
audienceState.desiredState: Back to running, hiking, and playing without thinking about the knee at all, with a simple routine they trust to keep it that way.

urgencyGateway.problem: Every flare-up costs them two to three weeks of the season, and each one takes a little longer to settle than the last.
urgencyGateway.whyUrgent: The pattern is getting worse, the next event they care about is on the calendar, and everything they have tried so far only manages the symptom.
failedSolutions: Resting until it stops hurting, then re-injuring it the first week back
Generic stretching videos that never address their specific movement pattern
A knee brace that helps on the day but changes nothing underneath
urgencyGateway.aspirinSolution: A guided six-week rebuild programme that finds the movement fault behind the flare-ups and fixes it with three short sessions a week.

painPoints.pain: Nobody has told them why the pain keeps coming back
painPoints.emotionalContext: They have seen two professionals, done the exercises, and still do not have an explanation they believe. The uncertainty is worse than the pain.

realQuotes.text: Example quote. Replace with a real one from your research, word for word.

painPoints.pain: Losing the identity that comes with being active
painPoints.emotionalContext: Saying no to the weekend trail run means watching a part of themselves fade. They minimise it out loud and worry about it privately.

realQuotes.text: Second example quote. Every quote in a real playbook is verbatim from a real source.

desirePhrases: get back to my old self
fix the cause, not the symptom

searchPhrases.phrase: knee pain comes back after rest
searchPhrases.context: Searched after the second or third flare-up, when resting has visibly failed.
Searched by people who have been told surgery is the eventual path and want an alternative.

emotionalTriggers: Fear of the next flare-up taking the season
Relief at finally hearing a mechanism that makes sense
Pride in rebuilding rather than avoiding

contentStrategyTips: Name the mechanism behind the pain before naming the offer
Use the audience's own phrases from the language map, not clinical terms
Every claim carries a real example or none at all
marketingRecommendation.quickWin: Publish one post answering the exact search phrase 'knee pain comes back after rest' in plain language.

marketGaps: Nobody explains the mechanism in plain language before selling the fix

offerStatement.finalStatement: Rebuild the knee that keeps letting you down in six weeks, without surgery and without giving up your season.

theOfferGivesYou: A movement assessment that names the fault behind the flare-ups
A six-week rebuild programme with three short sessions a week
A weekly check-in that adjusts the plan to how the knee responds
youCanUseItTo: Get back to running without watching the ground
Start the season you had written off
Stop paying for sessions that only treat the symptom
